description: Offline behavior of the invariant guard, the Unicode cleaner and the red-team output scorer, driven the way SKILL.md, references/semantic-fidelity.md, references/mark-classes.md and evaluation/README.md document them.

cases.behavior: A rewrite that keeps every number, unit and marker passes the invariant guard with nothing missing, added or flagged.
Changing 10 MB to 10 KB fails the guard through the number_unit_pairs category, as the calibration cases require.

warnings: New invariant-like tokens were introduced; review for factual drift.

cases.behavior: A dropped negation keeps every invariant, so the default guard still exits 0 and only warns, as the docs say an inverted claim can pass.

cases.behavior: A missing rewrite file is an unreadable input, so the guard exits 2 instead of returning a verdict.

cases.behavior: Cleaning prose from stdin removes a zero-width space, turns a no-break space into a plain space and reports both counts on stderr.
In --check mode a file that cleaning would change exits 1 so CI can stop it.
In --check mode a file with nothing to clean exits 0 and reports no change.
A saved output that keeps the source passes the automatic checks while manual review stays not_performed, and missing outputs keep the run at exit 1.
